title: Asiad: Filipinas boost quarterfinals hopes with 2-0 win over Hong Kong
summary: The Philippine women's national football team earned three points with a 2-0 win over Hong Kong in its second match of the 2026 Asian Games on Thursday at the Gifu Nagaragawa Stadium, Japan.
